name: govuk-delegate-prototype
description: Independent prototype: GOV.UK Delegate, a mock HMRC service and a demo agent, as separate services. Not an official GOV.UK service.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n delegate,hmrc,agent -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev -w apps/delegate" "npm:dev -w apps/hmrc --if-present" "npm:dev -w apps/agent --if-present"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --workspaces --if-present && npm run db:seed --workspaces --if-present
